plan: Turn 1: Whimsicott sets Tailwind with Prankster priority while Rillaboom uses Fake Out on the biggest threat. Focus Sash keeps Whimsicott alive for one hit.
Under Tailwind, Volcarona uses Quiver Dance once while a partner takes attention, then Heat Wave hits both foes. Grassy Terrain triggers its Grassy Seed.
Milotic's Icy Wind is a second spread move and speed control when Tailwind is down. Intimidate and stat drops raise its Special Attack (Competitive).
Mega Metagross removes Fairies and Sneasler. Ice Punch hits Dragons and Flying types; keep Metagross away from strong Fire or Ground attacks.
Against Trick Room, use Encore or Protect to use up its turns. Volcarona's Quiver Dance boosts still count after Trick Room ends.
cautions: Fire hits Metagross, Rillaboom and Whimsicott super effectively. Milotic, Volcarona and Hydreigon take Fire; keep one of them in against Charizard-Mega-Y or Heat Wave.
Whimsicott takes 4× from Poison and Rillaboom 2×. Metagross is immune; lead it against Sneasler.
Rock moves hit Volcarona 4×. Keep it in the back against Rock Slide leads such as Tyranitar.
Whimsicott and Rillaboom are both Grass, so Flying and Ice moves can hit both of them at once.

roles.Metagross: Mega attacker. Psychic Fangs for Fighting and Poison types, Ice Punch for Dragons and Flying types, Stomping Tantrum for Fire and Steel.
roles.Rillaboom: Fake Out, Grassy Glide priority and terrain. High Horsepower for Steel, Fire and Poison types.
roles.Hydreigon: Life Orb special attacker. Draco Meteor and Dark Pulse for Dragons, Ghosts and Psychics; Earth Power for Steel types.
roles.Whimsicott: Prankster Tailwind setter with Focus Sash. Encore locks a foe into a setup or Protect; Moonblast for Dragons and Fighting types.
roles.Volcarona: Spread damage and win condition. Quiver Dance, then Heat Wave and Bug Buzz. Grassy Seed gives +1 Def in Grassy Terrain.
roles.Milotic: Bulky Water. Icy Wind for spread speed control, Scald for burns, Ice Beam for Dragons and Flying types. Competitive punishes Intimidate.

archetypes.Sun: Lead Milotic. Keep Metagross, Rillaboom and Whimsicott away from Charizard's Heat Wave.
archetypes.Rain: Rillaboom, Whimsicott and Hydreigon take Water well. Volcarona waits until the rain ends.
archetypes.Sand: Grassy Glide, High Horsepower and Scald punish Ground, Rock and Steel types. Watch Rock Slide on Volcarona.
archetypes.Snow / Aurora Veil: Break the setter before Aurora Veil goes up: Fake Out it or target it on turn 1. Heat Wave hits Ice types hard.
archetypes.Trick Room: Hit the setter on turn 1. If Trick Room goes up, Encore or Protect to use up its turns.
archetypes.Psychic Terrain: Fake Out and Grassy Glide fail in Psychic Terrain, and Grassy Seed does not trigger. Prankster Tailwind still works, because it targets your own side.
archetypes.Tailwind offense: Match Tailwind with Whimsicott at once, and use Protect to use up theirs. Icy Wind slows them after it ends.
archetypes.Redirection + setup: Heat Wave and Icy Wind ignore redirection. Encore the setup move.
archetypes.Fake Out balance: Intimidate raises Milotic's Special Attack and does not affect the special attackers. Lead Milotic or Hydreigon.
archetypes.Screens: Attack the screen setter early, or Encore it into the screen move. Quiver Dance through the screens.
archetypes.Mega Flying Tailwind: Ice Punch from Metagross and Ice Beam from Milotic. Keep Rillaboom, Whimsicott and Volcarona away from Flying moves.
archetypes.Raichu offense: Stomping Tantrum from Metagross and Earth Power from Hydreigon. Rillaboom and Hydreigon resist Electric.
archetypes.Metagross mirror: Heat Wave from Volcarona, Dark Pulse from Hydreigon and Earth Power. Scald can burn it.
